entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4652001643815346176 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/hv-2405/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 2405: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 63519.3 +/- 6336.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 63519.3 +/- 6336.9 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax -0.0134 +/- 0.0188 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95), -0.7 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 2.195, 0.232 mas/yr. Radial velocity: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 4652001643815346176 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 20,000,000 of its distance per century (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia%20DR3%204652001643815346176).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 60.8 +/- 6 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 2405: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 60.8 +/- 6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 42,298,560 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5625 +/- 125 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC1327, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5625 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 4652001643815346176: 3 G-band harmonics of a 6.9238219707180315 d period, peak-to-peak 0.410 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.02 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,625 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.07 +/- 0.005 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffefe5. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,625 K and log g 0.4 (u1 0.556, u2 0.148): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Unmeasured, bounded: no gravity of this star is published (none in SIMBAD); Luck (2018), AJ 156, 171, table 3 (the spectroscopic gravities of its Cepheid spectra) gives the class's range, log g -1.33 to 2.86. Across log g 0 to 2.85, the part the grid covers, the limb laws differ by at most 1.9% of the centre brightness from the one drawn, at log g 0.4, the gravity closest to all of them; log g 0.4 is a display choice, not a measurement.
